questions.label: Cryo sleep save corruption on PS5
questions.question: Why does my save get corrupted after cryo sleep on PS5, and is it fixed?

response.answer: Your save was corrupted because the console was suspended (rest mode) while the cryo-sleep autosave was still being written, so both the main slot and its backup failed their checksum [BUG-0001] [CRASH-0001]. This is fixed: patch 1.0.1 writes cryo-sleep autosaves atomically, so suspending the console mid-save no longer corrupts the save or its backup [PATCH-1.0.1]. Update to 1.0.1 or later; saves already corrupted before the patch cannot be recovered by the game.

sources.title: Lost my entire 40 hour save after using the cryo pod
sources.snippet: Last night I went into the cryo pod to skip the night like always, the screen faded and I put my PS5 into rest mode while it was still on the 'Entering cryo-sleep' screen. Today when I load the game it says 'Save data is corrupted and cannot be loaded'

sources.title: Patch 1.0.1: fix for BUG-0001
sources.snippet: Cryo-sleep autosaves are now written atomically; suspending the console mid-save no longer corrupts the save or its backup.

questions.label: Hover-rover crashes
questions.question: What crashes happen when driving the hover-rover?

response.answer: One crash is on record for the hover-rover: on PC in 1.0.1 the rover's vertical velocity became NaN after its hover raycasts returned no hit, which crashed the game [CRASH-0006]. It is related to the rover losing terrain collision on steep tiles in Ridge Canyon [BUG-0004] [BUG-0019]. Other rover reports, such as bouncing over base foundations, are physics bugs rather than crashes [BUG-0021].

sources.snippet: NaN vertical velocity on the hover-rover after the hover raycasts returned no hit over a terrain seam.

sources.title: Hover-rover falls through the ground in Ridge Canyon
sources.snippet: Driving the hover-rover down the steep slope into Ridge Canyon, the rover sometimes drops straight through the terrain and lands under the map.

sources.title: Hover-rover loses terrain collision on steep tiles in Ridge Canyon (sector C4)

questions.label: Cross-save between PC and Switch
questions.question: Is cross-save between PC and Switch supported?

response.answer: Yes. Cross-save arrived in patch 1.2.0 (the Deep Core update) for all platforms, including PC and Switch, once you link your Starfall account on each platform [PATCH-1.2.0] [DOC-coop-and-cross-save]. If you see the conflict dialog, update to 1.2.1 first: it fixes a bug where choosing Keep Local loaded the older cloud save [BUG-0042] [PATCH-1.2.1].

sources.title: Co-op and Cross-Save Guide - Cross-save
sources.snippet: Cross-save lets you continue the same outpost on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series and Nintendo Switch. Link your Starfall account on each platform.

sources.title: Patch 1.2.0 notes
sources.snippet: The Deep Core update: mining lasers, Tier 2 fusion reactors and cross-save.

sources.title: Cross-save conflict dialog loads the older cloud save when 'Keep Local' is chosen
sources.snippet: Choosing Keep Local in the cross-save conflict dialog loaded the older cloud save instead.

sources.title: Patch 1.2.1: fix for BUG-0042
sources.snippet: The cross-save conflict dialog now keeps the local save when Keep Local is chosen.

response.answer: Patch 1.3.1 was a performance and progression fix for Outpost Alliance [PATCH-1.3.1]. It reduced host frame-time spikes in 8-player sessions on PS5 [BUG-0050], fixed a crash when a second player opened a trade terminal that was already closing [CRASH-0018], and fixed shared research progress not being granted to late joiners.

Yes. Patch 1.0.1 writes cryo-sleep autosaves atomically, so putting your PS5 into rest mode mid-save no longer corrupts the save or its backup. That's from the 1.0.1 patch notes and bug report BUG-0001.
I want to report a bug: my hover-rover falls through the map on Switch, version 1.4.0.

Thanks. That looks like a duplicate of BUG-0004, the hover-rover falling through the ground in Ridge Canyon, so I haven't drafted a new issue. You can still file it anyway from the bug panel on screen.
You're welcome. Anything else about Starfall Outpost?
